1. (Currently Amended) A humeral implant comprising a first component removably attached to a second component, wherein said first and second components are modular and interchangeable.

2. (Currently Amended) The humeral implant of claim 1 wherein said first component is a humeral surface component and said second component is a removably attached stem, wherein said humeral surface component and stem are not integrally formed.

3. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component has a coronal radius of curvature and an axial radius of curvature, and wherein said humeral surface component is configured to articulate with a glenoid.

9. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component is spherically or elliptically shaped and further comprises a textured or roughened articulating surface.

13. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 3 wherein said humeral surface component has a smooth articulating surface and is configured for anatomic restoration of the humeral head.

20. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said removably attached stem is provided in a plurality of different lengths, wherein a selected stem of a particular length extends from a lateral cortex of said humerus to a center of a head of said humerus.

21. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 2 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem via a removable connection mechanism.

22. (Currently Amended) The implant of claim 21 wherein said humeral surface component connects to said removably attached stem by a technique selected from the group consisting of morse taper and a screw connection.

27. (Currently Amended) A glenohumeral joint implant adapted to be implanted in a glenohumeral joint, comprising an implant configured to provide a transhumeral portal along a central axis of a neck of a proximal humerus.

28. (Currently Amended) The glenohumeral joint implant of claim 27 wherein said implant is a humeral implant.

29. (Currently Amended) A humerus bone implant comprising a modular implant with a humeral surface component and a stem, wherein said implant is adapted to be anchored in the epiphyseal-metaphyseal portion of a humerus bone.
